Cost: 1,500eb (Very Expensive)

The Berserker from BioDyne is an affordable and versatile OS for those who want quick and easy results, but don't expect miracles. It does what it says on the box, so let's not get picky.

Berserk Operating System. Berserk’s duration is reduced to 15 seconds (5 Rounds), and Non-FBC users without a Cyberspine now suffer a -4 penalty to all Ranged Attacks while Berserk is active.

While Berserk is active, any of the following Actions may be done as half of a ROF 2 Action: Equip/Drop Shield, Get Up, Grab, Human Shield, and any Action taken to activate an item or cyberware, clear a jam, put yourself out while On Fire, or stow a weapon. Additionally, while Berserk is Active, once per Round when the user’s Brawling, Martial Arts, or Melee Weapon Attack deals at least 4 damage to a target (after any armor and damage reduction), that Attack counts as if the user hit the target twice for the purposes of Martial Arts Special Move Requirements.

Enhances: Berserk
Option Slots: 0 (Cyberware Enhancement)

Foundry notes:

  • Every Operating System is incompatible with every other Operating System and with the base cyberware it is for: none of them can be installed while another OS, or that OS's own base cyberware, is anywhere in the user's body or in a worn apparatus they're connected to. The sheet doesn't enforce that.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Operating Systems > Berserk Operating Systems).
